hypotheses: A positive entropy bonus may reverse or reduce log-standard-deviation contraction on the same PPO batch.
If the current actor loss dominates, 0.001 and 0.01 may have little effect despite the theoretical entropy gradient.
Larger bonuses may change PPO clipping or update counts; track those instead of interpreting a noise increase as a return improvement.
